app_description: Recipes, meal planning, and shopping for your household.
plan_empty_description: Your next meals will appear here, in the order you want to cook them. Start with your recipe collection.
queue.add_hint: Choose servings for your household. You can leave the date open.
queue.added: Recipe added to your meal plan.
queue.order_hint: Drag a meal by its handle, use the arrow keys on the handle, or open its menu to change the cooking order. Dates do not change this order.
queue.cooked_saved: Marked as cooked and removed from your plan.
queue.skipped_saved: Meal skipped and removed from your plan.
queue.select_hint: Select the meals you want to shop for below.
queue.staples_hint: These ingredients are marked as pantry staples and will be left off the shopping list.
queue.include_staples: Include these pantry staples as well
queue.preview_stale: The meals, ingredients or pantry have changed. Refresh the preview before confirming again.
queue.remove_hint: Shopping items are kept unless you choose the option below. Manual items and contributions from other meals are always kept.
queue.remove_items: Also remove shopping items linked to this planned meal
list_empty_description: Ingredients for your planned meals will have a place here. Your meal plan is the starting point.
shopping.no_lists_hint: Create a list above to start shopping together.
shopping.empty_hint: Add an item above or add ingredients from a recipe.
shopping.catalog_linked: Linked to the ingredient catalog. Changing the name removes the link.
shopping.no_catalog_results: No matching ingredients. You can add your own item by name.
shopping.invalid_quantity: Enter a quantity greater than zero and no more than 1,000,000, or leave it empty.
shopping.edit_entries: Edit the {count} individual entries. Quantities and recipe sources are kept separately.
shopping.recipe_needs_list: Create a shopping list first, then add this recipe.
shopping.recipe_added: {count} ingredients added to your shopping list.
shopping.sync_rejected: Some changes could not be saved. The list may have been deleted or the entries are no longer valid.
shopping.local_storage_error: Changes could not be saved on this device. Check that your browser allows local storage and try again.
settings_saved: Changes are saved on this device automatically.
pwa_update_available: A new version of yumi is available.
pwa_install_description: Keep recipes, your meal plan, and your list within reach.
pwa_install_manual: Use your browser menu to install. On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
pwa_installed: yumi is installed on this device.
pwa_install_error: Installation could not be started. Try your browser menu.
pwa_offline: You're offline. Previously saved pages are still available.
errors.not_a_member: You are not a member of this household.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_found: This item could not be found.
errors.invite_invalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired.
errors.invalid_input: Please check your entries and try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
auth.sign_in_description: Sign in to plan meals and shop together.
auth.sign_up_description: Recipes, meal planning and a shared shopping list for your household.
auth.name: Your name
auth.error_user_exists: An account with this email already exists.
auth.error_password_short: The password must have at least 8 characters.
auth.error_invalid_email: Please enter a valid email address.
onboarding.title: Hi {name}, let's set up your household
onboarding.description: Recipes, plans and shopping lists belong to a household. You can invite others later.
onboarding.invite_hint: Got an invite link? Just open it to join an existing household.
invite.title: Invitation
invite.description: You have been invited to join the household "{household}".
household.title: Household
household.invites_description: Anyone with an invite link can join this household for 7 days.
household.leave_confirm: Do you really want to leave this household?
household.error_last_owner: You are the only owner. Remove the other members or delete the household instead.
recipes.empty_description: Add your first recipe. Paste the ingredient list and yumi turns it into tidy lines.
recipes.no_results_description: Try a different search or tag.
recipes.delete_confirm: Do you really want to delete "{title}"?
recipes.title: Title
recipes.tags_hint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag.
recipes.image_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 10 MB.
recipes.paste_hint: One ingredient per line, e.g. "200 g flour".
errors.invalid_ingredient: One of the linked ingredients no longer exists. Please check the list.
errors.invalid_image: This file is not a supported image. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
errors.image_too_large: The image is too large. The maximum is 10 MB.
stores.title: Stores
stores.description: Each store can sort the categories of your list in the order you walk through it.
stores.name: Store name
stores.empty_hint: Add the stores you shop at to sort your list by their aisles.
stores.category_order_hint: Drag the categories or use the arrows to match the route through the store.
stores.delete_confirm: Delete the store "{name}"? Lists using it fall back to the default order.
shopping.quick_hint: Type an amount and an item, then press Enter or pick a suggestion.
pantry.title: Pantry staples
pantry.description: Staples are always at home. They are skipped when you add a recipe to a shopping list, and you can still add them if you run out.
pantry.empty_hint: Add things like salt, oil or pepper that you always have at home.
pantry.check_hint: These staples were not added to the list.
recurring.title: Recurring items
recurring.description: These items go back on this list on their day when the list is opened. If the last one is still open, it is not added twice.
recipes.import_hint: Paste the link to a recipe page. You review the draft before anything is saved.
recipes.import_review: Review the imported draft and adjust it if needed. Nothing is saved until you choose “Save recipe”.
recipes.import_image_missing: The page image could not be imported. You can choose one yourself.
errors.import_no_recipe: No recipe data was found on this page.
errors.import_failed: The page could not be loaded. Check the link or try again later.
errors.import_invalid_url: This link cannot be imported. Use a public http or https address.
recipes.choose_description: Its ingredients and steps appear here.
